metadata.question: Does the burned area extent in Acre, Brazil increase in late September 2005 compared to late July 2005?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Burned Area MCD64A1 v6.1 for 2005 over Acre, Brazil (FAO GAUL level1). Compare burned area in late July (DOY 201–212) vs late September (DOY 263–273). Fallback to v6 if needed.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking (product is burned area). Mask pixels by BurnDate within the DOY windows. Also compute base valid pixel counts using the band mask to ensure coverage.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: If base valid pixel count is 0 for either month → C2. If reduceRegion returns null, treat burned area as 0 (valid zero). If dataset missing → C1. Catch unexpected errors → D.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function getInfo(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((v) => resolve(v), (e) => reject(e));
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const gaul1 = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1');
    const acre = gaul1
      .filter(ee.Filter.and(
        ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Brazil'),
        ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Acre')
      ))
      .geometry();

    const yearStart = '2005-01-01';
    const yearEnd = '2006-01-01';
    const julyStart = '2005-07-01';
    const julyEnd = '2005-08-01';
    const sepStart = '2005-09-01';
    const sepEnd = '2005-10-01';
    const scale = 1000;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    let datasetId = 'MODIS/061/MCD64A1';
    let colYear = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId)
      .filterDate(yearStart, yearEnd)
      .filterBounds(acre)
      .select('BurnDate');

    let yearCount = await getInfo(colYear.size());
    if (yearCount === 0) {
      datasetId = 'MODIS/006/MCD64A1';
      colYear = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId)
        .filterDate(yearStart, yearEnd)
        .filterBounds(acre)
        .select('BurnDate');
      yearCount = await getInfo(colYear.size());
      if (yearCount === 0) {
        console.log('No images in 2005 after fallback.');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    const julyCol = colYear.filterDate(julyStart, julyEnd);
    const sepCol = colYear.filterDate(sepStart, sepEnd);
    const julyCount = await getInfo(julyCol.size());
    const sepCount = await getInfo(sepCol.size());
    if (julyCount === 0 || sepCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Images 2005: ${yearCount} | July: ${julyCount} | Sep: ${sepCount}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    const julyImg = ee.Image(julyCol.first());
    const sepImg = ee.Image(sepCol.first());

    // 3. Processing helpers
    async function computeForWindow(img, startDOY, endDOY) {
      const b = img.select('BurnDate');
      const baseMask = b.mask(); // valid data mask
      const basePix = await getInfo(
        ee.Image(1).updateMask(baseMask).reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: acre,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e10
        }).get('constant')
      );

      const cond = b.gte(startDOY).and(b.lte(endDOY));
      const burnPixDict = await getInfo(
        ee.Image(1).updateMask(cond).reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: acre,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e10
        })
      );
      const burnedPix = burnPixDict ? burnPixDict.constant : 0;

      const areaDict = await getInfo(
        ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(cond).reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: acre,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e10
        })
      );
      const areaM2 = areaDict ? areaDict.area : 0;
      const areaKm2 = areaM2 ? areaM2 / 1e6 : 0;

      return { basePix: basePix || 0, burnedPix: burnedPix || 0, areaKm2: areaKm2 || 0 };
    }

    // DOY windows: July 20–31 => 201–212; Sept 20–30 => 263–273 (2005 non-leap year)
    const julyStats = await computeForWindow(julyImg, 201, 212);
    const sepStats = await computeForWindow(sepImg, 263, 273);

    // 4. Validation & Final Answer logic
    console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetId} (2005 imgs: ${yearCount})`);
    console.log(`July 20–31, 2005 (DOY 201–212): BurnPix=${Math.round(julyStats.burnedPix||0)}, Area_km2=${(julyStats.areaKm2||0).toFixed(2)}, BasePix=${Math.round(julyStats.basePix||0)}`);
    console.log(`Sep 20–30, 2005 (DOY 263–273): BurnPix=${Math.round(sepStats.burnedPix||0)}, Area_km2=${(sepStats.areaKm2||0).toFixed(2)}, BasePix=${Math.round(sepStats.basePix||0)}`);

    // Check for no valid pixels (C2)
    if ((julyStats.basePix || 0) === 0 || (sepStats.basePix || 0) === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels in one or both months after masking to valid data.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Check for calculation failure (NaN/invalid)
    const jArea = julyStats.areaKm2;
    const sArea = sepStats.areaKm2;
    if (jArea == null || sArea == null || isNaN(jArea) || isNaN(sArea) || jArea < 0 || sArea < 0) {
      console.log('Calculation failure or invalid values.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const increased = sArea > jArea;
    console.log(`Increase: ${increased ? 'Yes' : 'No'} (Sep ${sArea.toFixed(2)} vs Jul ${jArea.toFixed(2)} km²)`);

    // Final tag
    console.log(increased ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
